# graviteeam_certificate (Resource)

Manages a Gravitee AM Certificate (javakeystore, pkcs12)

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graviteeam_certificate" "example" {
  domain_id = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  name      = "JWT Signing Certificate"
  type      = "pkcs12-am-certificate"
  configuration = jsonencode({
    content   = jsonencode({ content = filebase64("cert.p12"), name = "cert.p12" })
    storepass = "changeit"
    alias     = "mykey"
    keypass   = "changeit"
    algorithm = "RS256"
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `configuration` (String, Sensitive) JSON configuration for the certificate plugin
- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain
- `name` (String) The name of the certificate
- `type` (String) The certificate plugin type (e.g. javakeystore-am-certificate, pkcs12-am-certificate)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the certificate
